subject: Retire stale Savegame_067 seek-point choices
description: DONE as source-verified no-fix. The nicouzouf Profile_001 Savegame_067 replay-008 frame-862 path mismatch is a stale Original capture, not a Rust behavior gap. The archived trace sends Soldier61 to (725,539), while current Rust sends it to (665,677). Direct decoding of current fullgame_linux Emb09_FoB_JMS.rhm's single HOLE chunk gives 236 authored directions unified by the shipped reverse AddIfNear scan into 73 points: point 29 is (665,677), point 62 is (725,539). At the frame-701 SeekArea construction boundary, Original PC109 and Rust PC107 both have direction 10; the exact forecast center is (889.2088012695312,507.6535339355469), with no door/lift forecast branch. Shipped RHArtificialMalignity::SeekArea classifies point 29 as sector 10, `(10+16-10)%15 == 1`, making it the same-layer primary obligatory point. Point 62 is sector 11, diff 2, and can only be the fallback when no primary point exists. Rust therefore faithfully inserts point 29 first. All global seek points are unlocked and no other seeker exists through frame 861. RHSeekPoint positions are mutable only during the one-time InitAI building-door teleport; no mission building door is within five units of point 29, and neither endpoint is a matching door position. RHPathFinder::AddPathRequest changes only an unauthorized source, never the goal, and RHParity::RecordPathQueued records request.ptGoal directly, ruling out path projection. Replay-009 from the same save independently records the same impossible Original goal (725,539) at frame 723, confirming a capture-family artifact rather than a one-frame Rust regression. Both traces are retired pending re-recording with the current Original build/assets; no Rust workaround was added. A local re-capture could not be executed on this host because the available Original binary is i386 and the host lacks /lib/ld-linux.so.2.
